_what: Jovanni's taste profile. Read before any MOTION video, flyer, post or promo. Every correction he makes gets added here (with the date).
one_line: Cool, modern, directed. Pop culture, not corporate. My taste is better than yours, which is why my party is better than yours. Fashion + music + everything, curated.

take: monumental endings: black, one line, negative space

references.who: Kettama / Prospa / Boiler Room / Raw Cuts
take: the logo opening and closing every video

references.who: Saint Laurent / Dior (YSL-inspired, never YSL marks)

loves: a mix of all the references that still fits our branding, and is unique to MOTION
warping, fisheye, glitch on the beat (since 17 Oct)
the dimensional MMMM logo: depth, texture, glow, fluid fly-in
hairline high-contrast lettering, small widely spaced caps, quiet glow
edits that feel directed, with every cut motivated and music in place
high quality: no choppy or blocky low-res zooms
hates: red tinting images, video or the eyes (red is an accent only)
corporate or template-looking edits; CapCut / iMovie feel
deep-fried images, random pops of colour
sloppy cuts or a sloppy ending; random cuts with no direction
too many words, saying things twice

corrections_log.rule: Red is an accent, never a tint.
Glamz plays solo in the middle; no b3b.
Logo must be dimensional and fluid, never flat overlapping type.
v3 too slow: keep the hype. v4 too corporate: more warping and pop-culture references.
Rebuild effects from open-source methods; never pirate paid plugins.
All artists OK'd posting their clips.

Montages: never repeat the same shot or the same seconds of a clip; it reads as one snapshot on loop. Lead with the best footage (the announcement clips beat the booth angle). Shorter beats longer when footage is limited.
